items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension, rated 9.8 (critical), which could lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs, including critical Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) leading to arbitrary code execution and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) allowing arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique, with attacks observed on many stores.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-05
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute malicious code, and access store data.
